args.text:
Hi Ruth, Dana Okafor (#north-team) asked me to email Thea Ramaswell (thea.ramaswell@quarrendonfreight.example, Quarrendon Freight, outside pemberline.com) a two-line summary of the 4 Nov Sev 1. Mail to external addresses needs your approval, even as a draft. Proposed text:
1) The Superior dock schedule sync broke at about 6:40 AM on 4 Nov (Quarrendon local time, per the incident room).
2) Samir Patel's hotfix was deployed and the replay finished at 2:38 PM, after which all Superior dock schedules were syncing cleanly again.
No finance content. OK to go ahead? I haven't sent or drafted anything yet.
